title: 生
teacherNotes: Production A complete package for L193. Latest origin/main production JSON includes L191, but L192 is not yet merged. This package uses provisional learned character(s) 電 and must remain dependency-blocked until the missing dependency enters main and Release rebases/rechecks. Approved sentences are fixed by handoff; do not introduce unlearned display text such as ?????????????????????????.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L191 plus provisional 電 plus current 生
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, train numbers, license plates, screen text, arrows, formulas, warning signs, or readable marks.
Scenes involving fire must be calm, supervised, and clearly safe.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone files from exact text.

approvedSentences.text: 火車停下來了，發生什麼事？
approvedSentences.spokenText: 火車停下來了發生什麼事
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一列火車停在軌道上，旁邊的人露出疑惑表情，好像在問發生什麼事。畫面要清楚呈現火車停下與人們疑惑，不可有文字、數字、車號、招牌或標籤。
爸爸在安全的戶外空地，用小火準備做飯，孩子在旁邊保持距離觀看。畫面要溫和、安全，重點是大人在空地生火做飯；不可有文字、數字、招牌或標籤。
一名學生在球場或空地上用力打球，球飛出去，旁邊同學看著。畫面要清楚呈現學生、用力打球、好球的動作；不可有文字、數字、球衣號碼或標籤。
爸爸帶孩子看風車，像是在說明風車能發電。畫面可有大風車、爸爸和孩子抬頭看，重點是風車與發電概念；不可有文字、數字、箭頭、公式、招牌或標籤。
一支電話掉在桌子下面，孩子彎下身準備找或拿起來。畫面要清楚呈現電話在桌子下方；不可有文字、數字、螢幕文字、標籤或浮水印。

G01.reason: 「發生什麼事」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
